title: Clayface Trailer Leans Into Body Horror: A DCU Game-Changer
excerpt: The debut Clayface trailer at San Diego Comic-Con signals a bold move into body horror for the DCU, with James Watkins directing and Alan Tudyk voicing Matt Hagen. This origin story promises to redefine superhero genre boundaries and showcase cutting-edge visual effects.
description: The debut Clayface trailer at San Diego Comic-Con brings body horror to the DCU. James Watkins directs Alan Tudyk as Matt Hagen in this tragic origin story.
